About Lucidya
Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that helps organizations understand, engage, and retain customers at scale.
Unlike traditional platforms that stop at reporting and dashboards, Lucidya combines proprietary AI, deep language understanding, and autonomous workflows to help organizations move from insight to action. Our technology is built in-house and trained on millions of multilingual customer conversations, enabling brands across the MENA region to make better decisions, deliver better experiences, and build stronger customer relationships.
As AI reshapes how businesses operate, we're building products that make customer understanding faster, more accurate, and more actionable than ever before.
Why This Role Matters
Most organizations today are overwhelmed with customer data.
Conversations are happening across social media, surveys, reviews, support tickets, messaging channels, and countless other touchpoints. The challenge isn't collecting the data anymore. It's knowing what matters and what to do next.
The Monitoring & Research domain sits at the center of that challenge.
This is where customers come to understand public perception, identify emerging trends, monitor competitors, measure customer sentiment, and uncover the insights that drive business decisions. It is one of the most strategically important parts of Lucidya 's platform and one of the biggest opportunities for innovation as AI transforms how research and customer intelligence are done.
As Senior Product Manager, you'll be responsible for shaping how thousands of users discover, trust, and act on insights generated from millions of customer conversations.
You'll be joining a team that values ownership over hierarchy, customer outcomes over feature output, and learning over certainty. We move quickly, challenge assumptions, and expect product leaders to bring strong opinions while remaining open to changing their minds when the evidence says otherwise.
If you're excited by complex customer problems, AI-powered products, and the opportunity to define the future of customer intelligence in a region where world-class solutions are still emerging, this role will give you significant room to make an impact.

Own the future of Monitoring & Research at Lucidya
You'll define the vision, strategy, and roadmap across three key product areas:
Social Listening
Managed Channels Analytics
Voice of Customer (VoC)
Your responsibility isn't simply delivering features. It's ensuring customers can confidently answer critical business questions about their customers, markets, competitors, and brand performance.
Turn customer signals into decisions
You'll spend significant time understanding how customers currently make decisions, where they struggle to find trustworthy insights, and what prevents them from taking action.
You'll use those learnings to build products that help customers move beyond reporting and toward clear recommendations, meaningful insights, and measurable business outcomes.
Lead discovery before delivery
You'll challenge assumptions, validate problems, and ensure we're solving issues that matter before resources are committed.
You'll regularly engage customers, prospects, Customer Success teams, and internal stakeholders to uncover opportunities and validate product direction.
Success in this role means building the right thing, not simply building things quickly.
Raise the quality bar for AI-powered insights
As AI becomes increasingly central to our platform, you'll help define what "trustworthy AI" means in practice.
You'll work closely with AI, Data, Design, and Engineering teams to improve:
Insight accuracy
Sentiment quality
Explainability
Relevance
Customer trust
You'll constantly ask whether an insight is genuinely useful, not just technically impressive.
Make difficult prioritization decisions
Not every good idea belongs on the roadmap.
You'll evaluate opportunities using customer feedback, product data, market insights, commercial priorities, and strategic impact.
You'll make trade-offs transparently and help the organization understand why certain bets are worth making while others are not.
Drive product adoption and business impact
You'll closely monitor customer behavior, adoption patterns, retention drivers, churn signals, and feedback loops.
You'll use those insights to continuously improve the product and ensure the work being delivered creates measurable value for both customers and the business.
Be a leader beyond product
You'll collaborate across Engineering, Design, AI, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Leadership teams.
You'll help create alignment, provide clarity during ambiguity, and contribute to building a culture where teams are empowered to solve problems rather than simply execute requirements.

You have strong product fundamentals
You have at least 5 years of product management experience, ideally within B2B SaaS environments.
You know how to take a problem from discovery through validation, delivery, measurement, and iteration.
You understand that product management is ultimately about creating customer and business value, not managing backlogs.
You simplify complexity
You're comfortable working with large datasets, analytics platforms, AI-powered products, or technically complex systems.
More importantly, you know how to transform complexity into experiences that feel intuitive and useful to customers.
You stay close to customers
You don't rely solely on internal opinions to make decisions.
You regularly speak with customers, investigate workflows, validate assumptions, and seek evidence before committing to a direction.
You're naturally curious about how people work and where products create friction in their lives.
You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information
You won't always have perfect data.
You can balance analysis with action, make informed decisions under uncertainty, and adapt when new information becomes available.
You communicate with clarity
You can explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and customer problems to technical teams.
You build alignment through clear thinking, structured communication, and transparency.
You care about outcomes
You measure success by customer adoption, customer value, and business impact rather than the number of features released.
You're willing to challenge existing thinking when you believe there's a better way to solve a problem.

What Success Looks Like

Your goal is to transform the Novakid Kid’s Area from a supplementary area into a significant driver of language acquisition for young kids. You will lead the development of self-guided English learning games and integrate cutting-edge AI-based self-practice tools that encourage children to speak more, practice safely, and stay motivated between their 1:1 teacher sessions.

Design and manage the "Economy of Fun," including avatars, star rewards, and other gamification features that compete for a child's attention against mainstream apps.
Work closely with designers, engineers, curriculum developers, and teacher operations to turn user insights into high-quality educational content and engaging UX.

Hands-on experience in AI-powered features (prompt engineering, conversational AI, or adaptive algorithms).
Strong background in mobile gaming or highly gamified EdTech, with a deep understanding of reward systems, level progression, and retention hooks.
Proven ability to build interfaces for 4–12-year-olds that are intuitive, safe, and require zero parental intervention.
Proficiency in analytical tools to analyze "incidental learning" metrics and game-completion rates.
Manage the Agile process with our engineering team, ensuring that prototypes are delivered and scaled with technical excellence.

And it is a privileged surface for customers to discover, try, buy and expand through a seamless self-serve experience, connecting product usage, onboarding and growth in one place. It unites forces with GTM to automate acquisition, upsell, cross-sell and retention, with end-to-end ownership of the customer persona. The area is evolving fast.

What began as a self-serve growth surface (Station) is becoming the customer-facing window into Veriff's accuracy and fraud advantage for our largest enterprise customers.
The shape of this role
This is an IC-first leadership role, and the first genuine step into product leadership — distinct from a strong senior IC. At first you will lead through craft, authority and influence. You own the strategy, discovery, roadmap and delivery for your product area.
As you refine the strategic themes for this large product, we expect you to propose the team configuration needed to support our growth and company objectives. That will move you progressively from IC to manager, while retaining hands-on ownership of at least one part of the Customer Portal area in the mid-term. We will deliberately assess for both the IC craft bar and the latent management capability, because the role is designed to traverse the line.

Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Customer Portal area, tied explicitly to Veriff's commercial model and revenue drivers.

s.h: What you get to do every day
s.t:
Customer and Market Understanding
Develop deep expertise in the personas we serve — corporate security, intelligence analysts, executive protection, threat assessment, brand and communications teams — including how their work is structured, staffed, measured, and escalated.
Interview customers and prospects continuously. Run discovery conversations, ride-alongs, and feedback sessions that produce specific problem statements rather than feature requests.
Maintain a clear, current view of the problems we solve well today, where we can improve, and the problems we should be solving 12 to 24 months from now.
Track industry trends, threat landscape shifts, platform and data-access changes, regulatory developments, and the competitive field, and translate them into implications for our roadmap.
Prioritization and Roadmap Ownership
Own a value stream in the Risk Intelligence roadmap: decide what we build, what we defer, and what we decline, with reasoning that stands up to scrutiny.
Balance business objectives, customer needs, and industry trends when sequencing work, and make the tradeoffs explicit to stakeholders.
Define the problem sets and jobs to be done that anchor each initiative, so the team understands the outcome before it debates the solution.
Working With Development and Design
Partner with Engineering and Design to translate customer problems into specifications, acceptance criteria, and deliverable milestones the team can execute against.
Break large initiatives into releasable increments that produce customer value early and inform what comes next.
Stay close through delivery — grooming, scope decisions, testing, and launch readiness — and resolve ambiguity before it becomes rework.
Prototyping With AI Tooling
Use AI development and design tools such as Claude Code, Claude Design, and Codex to build working prototypes, pressure-test concepts, and put something tangible in front of customers in days rather than quarters.
Treat prototypes as a research method: use them to invalidate weak ideas inexpensively and to sharpen strong ones before Engineering commits.
Bring that fluency to the wider product team and raise the bar for how quickly we can move from idea to evidence.
Measurement

# Product Manager Microsoft 365 Plattform & Digitale Zusammenarbeit (a) #

Microsoft 365 ist das digitale Rückgrat der Zusammenarbeit in der kantonalen Verwaltung und in den Schulen des Kantons Luzern. Wir bauen den Betrieb dieser Konzernplattform als eigene Organisation neu auf. Als Product Manager M365 verantwortest du, was auf dieser Plattform entsteht, in welcher Reihenfolge und mit welchem Nutzen für die Dienststellen und die Schulen.
Deine Aufgaben
* Du führst die Roadmap der M365-Plattform und priorisierst nach Wert und Risiko. Die Leitung sieht, was wann kommt, und kann steuern.
* Du baust den Zugang für die Dienststellen aus: eine Adresse für Anliegen, ein sichtbares Backlog, klare Zuständigkeit für jeden Entscheid. Kein Begehren versandet, keines geht an Entscheidungsgremien vorbei.
* Neue Dienste oder Apps bringst du zügig und nachweisbar zur Freigabe, gemeinsam mit Security, Datenschutz und den Fachverantwortlichen. Datenschutz ist für dich ein Qualitätsmerkmal und keine Bremse.
* Du machst transparent, was die Plattform und die einzelnen Dienste kosten, und legst sie verursachergerecht auf Verwaltung und Schulen um. Du unterstützt die Leitung bei der finanziellen Planung und Budgetierung.
* Du planst Rollouts mit Kommunikation und Befähigung und weist den Nutzen an Kennzahlen nach.
* Du baust das M365-Betriebsmodell mit auf, überführst Aufgaben vom externen Partner in die eigene Organisation und arbeitest im skalierten agilen Setup (SAFe) eng mit dem Product Owner, den DevOps Engineers, der Architektur und den Business Ownern zusammen.
Dein Profil
* Abgeschlossenes Studium oder gleichwertige Erfahrung in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Betriebswirtschaft mit ausgeprägtem IT-Bezug (HF, FH oder Universität).
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Manager, Product Owner oder Service Owner für eine Plattform mit vielen internen Kunden. Du hast eine Roadmap schon einmal gegen konkurrierende Interessen durchgesetzt.
* Substanz auf der Plattform: du beurteilst selbst, was ein Begehren technisch bedeutet. Teams-, Meeting- und App-Policies, Berechtigungs- und Sharing-Modell in SharePoint Online und OneDrive, Gastzugriffe und deren Lebenszyklus in Entra ID, Sensitivity Labels und Purview, Voraussetzungen für Copilot, Sicherheitsbaselines wie CIS Benchmark und Secure Score.
* Du merkst, wenn die Aussage eines Herstellers oder eines Partners nicht stimmt und kannst deinen Standpunkt technisch argumentieren.
* Verständnis moderner Betriebsmodelle: DevOps, Automatisierung, Configuration as Code und Auditierbarkeit im M365-Kontext.
* Erfahrung im skalierten agilen Umfeld (SAFe) mit Roadmap, Priorisierung, PI Planning und der Zusammenarbeit mit Business Ownern.
* Erfahrung in der öffentlichen Verwaltung oder einem regulierten Umfeld von Vorteil.
* Du wirkst ohne Weisungsbefugnis: du führst unterschiedliche Interessen zu tragfähigen Entscheiden und bleibst verbindlich.

Prioritize foundational investments based on customer impact, enterprise needs, technical risk, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs between near-term customer needs, technical debt, and long-term architecture explicit.
Lead product discovery for technically complex problems, engaging directly with enterprise customers and internal customer-facing teams.

Drive work on the scalability and reliability of n8n's execution engine, including areas like worker pools and distributed execution.
Improve the reliability of triggers and execution behaviour across complex deployment setups, from multi-main Cloud environments to self-hosted enterprise installations.
Shape a more secure and flexible approach to executing code within n8n.

Drive the planning and release of major or breaking platform versions, including migration strategy, stakeholder communication, and risk management.
Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.
Act as the bridge between the Core team and the wider org: Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Support, making platform trade-offs legible without oversimplifying them.
Treat internal product teams as customers of the platform: proactively mine their roadmaps for implicit platform requirements and turn cross-cutting needs into explicit Core Platform work before they become blockers.

Must-haves
Platform product experience: You have 5+ years in Product, with at least 2 to 3 years on platform, infrastructure, developer-facing, or backend/API products.
Technical depth: You're credible with senior engineers. You can reason about distributed systems, execution models, and reliability/scalability trade-offs, and hold your own in an architecture discussion. You're at home with non-functional requirements, where the details are the product.
Complex delivery track record: You've led cross-team technical initiatives with real delivery risk, ideally including a migration or breaking change.
Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or technical-debt work to customer and commercial outcomes.
Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.
Exceptional communication: You make complex platform topics understandable for technical and non-technical audiences alike.
Enterprise platform reality: You understand what running software in customer-controlled environments means, including self-hosted, air-gapped, and restricted deployments
Nice-to-haves
Hands-on ability: You can read code or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.
Enterprise exposure: You've worked with B2B SaaS requirements like security, compliance, or deployment complexity.
Security partnership: You're comfortable working with security teams on code execution, isolation, or compliance topics.
Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.
Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.

Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.
Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices .

With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels , including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.
We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic . We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst , and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.
Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, andthe results speak for themselves.
From day one, Insider One ’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world.

Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables , our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.
Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who wants to make the dream a reality.

We are visionaries who guide new product ideas. We are setting the vision for our growing family of products. We use data, research, strategy, and empathy to guide development and design teams toward a common goal since we believe that only our products can alter Insider One 's destiny. We are Insider One ’s innovators, our impact starts on day one, and our mission is to prove that break-through products can be created outside Silicon Valley.

Impact ; be a part of a world-class product team where we constantly get challenged with new things and the results of our actions create an impact for hundreds of millions of users every day.
Personal Growth ; work closely with some of the best people in their fields, join tons of different training like sales, design, customer communication. Develop the skills that you need to become an even more successful product manager.
Experience ; get important responsibilities, learn from your mistakes without getting blamed, watch experienced people work on complex matters, gain one of the most important things, experience.
Delight ; make tough decisions, release new features, create innovating products which bring ease and joy to the life of many individuals who use them.
Community ; surround yourself with great people who constantly help each other and push each other to be better, join many different events, and become a part of the Insider One Community.
What are we searching for?
Leadership , you can make decisions and set direction while motivating and inspiring people around you to follow you in that direction.
Communication , you serve as the diplomat of the team, you can transmit complex information to different audiences clearly and you are talented in reaching the information you need on the people you are talking to.
Problem Solving , you are a natural-born problem solver, finding solutions to complex problems motivate and excite you, and at that moment when you solve the problem, feeling that sense of accomplishment is worth all the effort.
Teamwork , you are easily able to work with people around you, help them when they need, give or take constructive feedback, despite any personal conflict between you and them.
Listening , despite the fact that communicating effectively is extremely important, you should also be able to gather information from many sources around you to help you make better-informed decisions on guiding and improving your products and services.
Entrepreneurial Spirit , rather than waiting to adapt to change, you are actively seeking out change. You have a mindset that embraces critical questioning, innovation, and improvement. You can see the big picture, you are willing to take risks, you constantly seek new opportunities for innovation and you take ownership and pride in what you do. What are you going to do?

You are going to be the person who is responsible for defining the why, when, and what of the products that the engineering team is building. This means you will be leading cross-functional teams with your communication starting from a product's ideation all the way through to its launch.
You will be responsible for building a product and strategy which reflects Insider One ’s vision. Your job is to clearly articulate the business value to the product team so they understand the intent behind the new product or product release.
You will be defining the release process and coordinating all of the activities required to bring the product to market.
You will be managing and prioritizing product items. You will be owning the creative process of generating, developing, and curating new ideas. You will be continuously benchmarking, monitoring, and understanding market needs and requirements, competition, customer/user requirements, and emerging technologies.
You will be defining and analyzing the metrics to calculate how features or products are performing, what the level of customer satisfaction is, and provide suggestions for improvements.
You are going to do your best to create great products that everybody loves.
You will always remember that building great products is invigorating. Successful products are built and adopted by customers when a group of committed, focused, and passionate team members play their positions to the best of their abilities. This starts with a strong product manager who feels a deep sense of responsibility for their role and a deep commitment to their team.

s.h: Your mission as a Senior Product Manager
s.t:
We are seeking a proven, disciplined Senior Product Manager who has mastered the core crafts of product management—discovery, structured strategy, rigorous execution, and outcome-driven roadmap delivery within a B2B SaaS environment.
You will own the bridge between advanced machine learning systems and real-world customer value. You’ll partner closely with our engineering team and Engineering Leads to build our core AI architecture and harness, as well as AI-enabled user-facing features that keep Appinio ahead of the curve.

Craft and execute our AI strategy by shaping the end-to-end vision, value proposition, and roadmap for flagship AI initiatives, balancing long-term technical foundations with high-impact customer features.
Drive complete end-to-end product ownership, taking features from initial strategy and discovery through to architecture, execution, iteration, and measurable business impact.
Build and scale our internal AI harness through direct partnership with your cross functional engineering squad and their Lead to establish robust evaluation frameworks, LLM orchestration, model routing, and prompt engineering infrastructure that keep our systems reliable, scalable, and cost-effective.
Practice rigorous product craft through deep user discovery, clear and actionable PRDs, tracking and tight success metrics (OKRs), and disciplined execution driven by rapid experimentation.
Elevate team AI and PM fluency by leading as an AI-native PM, mentoring cross-functional team members, and fostering a culture of continuous learning, data fluency, and high performance.

s.h: You will thrive in this role if
s.t:
You bring essential B2B SaaS experience with a proven track record of owning platform products end-to-end, alongside a deep understanding of multi-tenant workflows, complex user personas, and scaling software.
You possess battle-tested PM fundamentals, backed by several years of experience as a Product Manager with demonstrated mastery in core PM frameworks, quantitative/qualitative research, and outcome-based execution.
You have a hands-on AI/ML track record, including direct experience working with AI engineers/teams to bring non-deterministic software, LLM applications, or agentic frameworks into production. Experience with LLM-as-a-judge.
You maintain a strong technical and strategic balance, able to speak the language of engineering (RAG, vector databases, model evals, API latency) while translating technical capabilities into measurable business impact (revenue, efficiency, retention).
You communicate with precision. Complex AI tradeoffs become a clear recommendation, a decision, and a quality bar other squads can reuse.
You have an interest and a passion in the products we are building at Appinio with the vision to create the coolest market-research product in the world

Uber is building the systems, infrastructure, and operating models needed to help autonomy partners deploy commercially and serve riders at scale. As Uber expands support for remote assistance across more partners, markets, and vehicle platforms, remote assistance becomes a core commercialization capability: the human support layer that helps autonomous vehicles navigate ambiguity, recover gracefully, and operate reliably in the real world.
As the Lead Product Manager, Remote Assistance, you will lead the remote assistance product area and own the end-to-end success of Uber's remote assistance product. RA is a critical aspect of Uber's integrated AV support system, and you will play a key role in building best-in-class RA support for scaled commercial AV deployments.

You will define when remote assistance is invoked, what operators can see and do, how edge cases are escalated and resolved, and how performance is measured and improved over time.

You will work across engineering, product design, operations, safety, systems engineering and partner teams to build a scalable remote assistance product that can support multiple autonomy stacks, different vehicle capabilities, and varying market constraints.

You will translate operational and technical complexity into clear product decisions, adapt and evolve Uber's RA product to new partnerships, and scale RA support for key partners globally.
This role is ideal for a product leader with experience in autonomy, remote operations, or other complex real-time systems, and who is comfortable building products where safety, reliability, and operational rigor matter as much as user experience.

Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for Uber's remote assistance platform, defining how human operators support autonomous vehicle operations across partners and markets.
Define the end-to-end remote assistance system, including operator tooling, escalation triggers, decision boundaries, resolution workflows, auditability, and handoff points between autonomy systems and human operators.
Build a scalable product platform that supports multiple partner integrations, vehicle platforms, operating models, and regional requirements without fragmenting the operator experience.
Partner closely with engineering and autonomy teams to define system interfaces, backend services, data flows, and latency and reliability requirements needed for high-quality real-time support.
Work with operations teams to design operator workflows, staffing assumptions, training inputs, and quality processes that enable effective day-to-day execution.
Establish metrics and feedback loops to evaluate safety, intervention quality, response latency, operator efficiency, resolution outcomes, and rider impact.
Collaborate with safety, legal, and policy partners to define guardrails, escalation protocols, and incident review processes for remote assistance operations.
Drive launch readiness for new partners, features, and geographies, ensuring remote assistance capabilities are in place before commercial deployment.
Use learnings from field operations, incidents, and partner changes to prioritize roadmap improvements and reduce unnecessary human intervention over time.
Communicate strategy, tradeoffs, performance, and key risks clearly to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Demonstrated experience owning and delivering complex, technical products in autonomy, robotics, mobility, or other real-time operational systems.
Strong product judgment and the ability to translate ambiguous technical and operational problems into clear product requirements, roadmap decisions, and execution plans.
Experience working closely with engineering, operations, safety, and cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end systems.
Experience with human-in-the-loop, remote operations, dispatch, control center, or other workflows where real-time decision-making, latency, and reliability are critical.
Ability to define success metrics, prioritize roadmaps, and drive execution across multiple internal and external stakeholders.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience representing product direction with senior leaders and partners.

Experience working on autonomous vehicles, robotics, or other autonomy systems.
Direct experience building, launching, or managing remote assistance, teleoperation, or remote driving systems.

Background in systems engineering or experience working deeply across hardware, software, and operations.
Experience building products that span multiple partners, platforms, or operational environments.
